description: This file contains implementations of various big number (BN) arithmetic functions such as multiplication, squaring, and division, primarily used within cryptographic computations. It includes low-level optimized routines for word-wise arithmetic operations.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_add_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Multiplies a set of words by a single word, adds the product to a result array, and returns the final carry.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_mul_words(BN_ULONG * rp,BN_ULONG * ap,int num,BN_ULONG w)
methods.description: Performs word-wise multiplication of two arrays with a single word and accumulates the result.

methods.name: void bn_sqr_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,int n)
methods.description: Squares an array of words, used for big number squaring.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_div_words(BN_ULONG h,BN_ULONG l,BN_ULONG d)
methods.description: Performs division of a 64-bit number by a single word, returning the quotient.

methods.name: BN_ULONG bn_add_words(BN_ULONG * r,BN_ULONG * a,BN_ULONG * b,int n)
methods.description: Adds two arrays of words and returns the carry-out.
